name: ブロット
tagline: 2チームで遊ぶブルガリア式ブロット。ビッド、宣言、151点まで。
description: ブラウザで無料のブルガリア式ブロット。ビッド、コントラ、テルツやブロットの宣言をして、パートナーと151点を目指そう。ボット、1台で、またはオンラインで。
about: Belote is the most popular card game in Bulgaria, and this is the Bulgarian version, sometimes called bridge-belote. Four players play in two teams of two, partners sitting opposite each other, with a deck of 32 cards from seven to ace. Play goes counter-clockwise, to the right.

Each player is dealt five cards, and then the bidding begins. You can pass or call a contract higher than the last one: clubs, diamonds, hearts and spades make that suit trumps, No Trumps has no trumps and counts double, and All Trumps makes every suit a trump suit. The other team may double, and the bidders may redouble. When three players pass after a call, everyone gets three more cards and play begins.

You must follow suit; in a suit contract you must trump when you can't follow (and over-trump if you can) unless your partner is already winning. Points come from the cards taken, the last trick, declarations (sequences of three or more, four of a kind) and belote, the king and queen of trumps. The bidders must score more than their opponents, or everything goes to the opponents: they are inside. The first team to 151 game points wins. Play against bots, with friends on one device, or online, where the cards are dealt on our server.
howToPlay: Play vs bots or Play on this device. You and the player opposite are a team; play goes counter-clockwise.
With five cards each, bid: pass, or call a higher contract (clubs, diamonds, hearts, spades, No Trumps, All Trumps). Opponents may double; the bidders may redouble.

After three passes, everyone gets three more cards. Declarations are made automatically: tierce 20, quarte 50, quinte 100, four jacks 200, four nines 150, four aces, kings, queens or tens 100. Only the team with the best sequence scores its sequences.
Follow suit. In a suit contract, if you can't, trump (and over-trump if you can), unless your partner is winning. On a trump lead, and in All Trumps, play higher if you can.
Trumps: J 20, 9 14, A 11, 10 10, K 4, Q 3. Other suits: A 11, 10 10, K 4, Q 3, J 2. The last trick is 10, belote 20, all eight tricks 90 more. No Trumps counts double.
The bidders must score more than the opponents, or all points go to the opponents. The first team to 151 wins.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap a call to bid. Tap a card to lift it and tap it again to play, or drag it up.
Mouse: click a call or a card.
Keyboard: Tab to the calls and press Enter. Move through your hand with the arrow keys and press Enter to play.
On one device, the screen covers your hand between turns: pass the device, and the next player taps to see theirs.
tips: The jack and nine are the strongest trumps: with both, a suit contract is usually safe.
No Trumps wants aces and guarded tens; All Trumps wants jacks and nines.
Give points to your partner when they're winning the trick: a ten or an ace is worth 10 or 11.
Double only when you're sure: a doubled contract that's made scores double for the bidders.

faq.question: Is Belote free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Which rules does this Belote use?
faq.answer: Bulgarian rules: 32 cards, teams of two, play counter-clockwise, contracts from clubs to All Trumps with double and redouble, declarations and belote, and a game to 151.

faq.question: What does it mean to be inside?
faq.answer: The bidding team scored no more than the opponents. Then all the points of the deal go to the opponents.

faq.question: Do I have to announce declarations?
faq.answer: No. kefche announces tierces, quartes, quintes, carrés and belote for you, as play starts and when you play the king or queen of trumps.

faq.question: Can other players see my cards online?
faq.answer: No. Online, the cards are dealt on our server, which sends each player only their own hand. Calls and declarations are public, as at a real table.
